gui.skyabyss.mount.hint: Stats carry over to any look. Click to raise one tier.
gui.skyabyss.mount.title: Mounts
item.skyabyss.mount_whistle.desc: A stable whistle. Blow it and your mount comes to you.
item.skyabyss.mount_whistle.use: Right-click to call, again to send back. Also works from the pouch: tap Y (pouch tool key)
message.skyabyss.mount.bought_look: Bought %s and set it as your look
message.skyabyss.mount.refuse_abyss: Mounts cannot be called in the abyss.
message.skyabyss.mount.refuse_back: Mounts cannot be called on a titan's back.
message.skyabyss.mount.refuse_riding: You can't call a mount right now.
mount.skyabyss.look.ash_deer.desc: A tall antlered deer, grey as cinders. Long-legged and made for distance.
mount.skyabyss.look.great_lizard.desc: A low, broad lizard that hugs the ground. Steady under any load.
mount.skyabyss.look.ember_fox.desc: A fire-kit of the ember titan. A coal glows at its tail tip. Light and nimble.
mount.skyabyss.look.horn_beast.desc: A sturdy, broad-backed pack beast with heavy horns. Lent to every traveller from the start.
mount.skyabyss.look.shell_tortoise.desc: Kin of the tide-shell titan. Slow to look at, quick on its feet. You sit on the wide shell.
mount.skyabyss.look.storm_chick.desc: A chick of the thunder-wing titan. Lightning runs through its fluff. Tall, with a fine view.
mount.skyabyss.look.whale_calf.desc: A calf of the stone whale. Mossy slabs on its back, fins that tread the ground.
message.skyabyss.mount.health_refund: Mount health tiers are gone (health is always at the old maximum). Refunded %s bell coins for the tiers you bought
mount.skyabyss.look.abyss_gecko.desc: A great gecko kept by the abyss lamp keepers. Lantern sacs glow on its shoulders and tail.
mount.skyabyss.look.star_lynx.desc: A great lynx of the moon fields. Stars glint in its night-blue fur; a crescent glows at its tail.
mount.skyabyss.look.sky_ray.desc: A great ray that swims the cloud sea. It flies where you look (jump to flap).
message.skyabyss.mount.locked.ch6: Not in stock yet (unlocks in chapter 5, past the abyss gate)
message.skyabyss.mount.locked.ch7: Not in stock yet (unlocks once you reach the moon)
message.skyabyss.mount.locked.ch8: Not in stock yet (unlocks after the finale)
message.skyabyss.mount.tandem_party: Only the rider's party members can ride behind
mount.skyabyss.sprint.east: East Sprint (road to the eastern shore)
message.skyabyss.sprint.start: %1$s has begun: ride through %2$s rings of light (dismount to stop)
message.skyabyss.sprint.off_mount: You dismounted, so the sprint stopped
message.skyabyss.sprint.timeout: The sprint took too long and stopped
message.skyabyss.sprint.strayed: You left the road, so the sprint stopped
message.skyabyss.sprint.first: Finished %1$s for the first time: %2$s coins
gui.skyabyss.mount.name_hint: Up to %s characters. Leave empty to remove the name
message.skyabyss.mount.bond.1: Your bond with %s deepened (I): it comes running when whistled
message.skyabyss.mount.bond.2: Your bond with %s deepened (II): name it at the travel keeper
message.skyabyss.mount.bond.3: Your bond with %s deepened (III): tassels on the saddle
message.skyabyss.mount.name_locked: You can name your mount from bond II (20 km ridden)
